prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a sharply graduated chin-length bob with a close-cropped nape and short broken bangs; costume silhouette a skin-tight bodysuit with chrome cybernetic arm or leg sections showing through cut-outs — a sleek half-machine silhouette; design idea Eight stepped bamboo-glass lamellae form the torso fastening and split hip armour, with a suspended glowing pendulum core integrated into the sternum clasp.; face heart-shaped face, almond-shaped eyes of natural size; expression a faint knowing smile.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Taiwanese woman — the personification of the city of Taipei — one woman who IS Taipei as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cool, aloof beauty; fair skin; heart-shaped face; almond-shaped eyes of natural size; amber eyes; straight brows of natural fullness; a straight nose with a slim bridge; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: toned athletic-curvy, full-busted with rounded hips build; a sharply graduated chin-length bob with a close-cropped nape and short broken bangs; deep navy-blue hair.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a courier vest and leggings armoured along her arms and legs in eight stacked, slightly flaring segments of translucent blue-green like the great tower's bamboo stalk, glowing curled cloud-scroll motifs on her shoulders, and a small polished steel sphere swinging on a cord at her chest like the tower's pendulum, its core glowing softly.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a skin-tight bodysuit with chrome cybernetic arm or leg sections showing through cut-outs — a sleek half-machine silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: Eight stepped bamboo-glass lamellae form the torso fastening and split hip armour, with a suspended glowing pendulum core integrated into the sternum clasp.
Colours: bamboo-glass jade green, roasted-oolong amber and pale sulphur yellow — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a tall sealed cup of brown-sugar pearl milk tea with a wide straw, its film lid glowing softly with a delivery seal; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Taipei two centuries from now, a far-future basin city: the great bamboo-segmented tower now stands at the heart of a forest of segmented towers of blue-green glass, a giant pendulum sphere glowing softly at the core of each, night markets float on tiers of light above the old streets, rivers of quiet hover scooters pour over the bridges at dawn, geothermal steam from the volcanic hills rises in soft white plumes to power the city, and gondolas of light glide out to tea terraces on the hills under a warm, humid night sky.
This card: on a curving sky bridge at dawn, a glowing river of quiet hover scooters pouring past her down the ramp toward the waking city.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
